abstract.para: You can use the Dashboard screen to monitor multiple clusters. The clusters must all be running the same version of &sleha;. The Dashboard screen has the following functions:

listitem.para: The main dashboard view shows the resources and nodes in the current cluster. For more information about the icons used in this view, click Legend. To search for a resource, use the Search text box. To only show specific nodes, click the filter icon and select a filtering option.
To add a dashboard for another cluster, click Add Cluster and enter the cluster details. &hawk; displays a second tab for the newly added cluster.

tip.title: Connection error
tip.para: If you are prompted to connect to this cluster by entering a password, you might not have replaced the self-signed certificate yet. In that case, even after you enter the password, the connection fails with the following message: Error connecting to server. Retrying every 5 seconds...
Replace the self-signed certificate, or log in to &hawk; on the new cluster's nodes and either verify the self-signed certificate or add an exception in the browser to bypass the warning.

listitem.para: To view more details for a cluster or to manage it, switch to the cluster's tab and click the chain icon. &hawk; opens the Status view for this cluster in a new browser window or tab.
To remove a cluster from the dashboard, click the x icon on the right-hand side of the cluster's details. You can only remove additional clusters, not the main cluster.
